name: courtship_song_mal_v2b
bridge_definition: All annotated mAL cells receiving negative vPN1 edges and sending negative edges to pC1, without activity-based selection

reference.evidence: The MaleCNS paper proposes vPN1 inhibits a male-specific mAL which inhibits pC1 (Figure S5G). This audit selects all matching signed two-edge motifs in the current IR, not a verified one-to-one map to the figure's specific cells.

scope: Exploratory literature-led follow-up after v2, not a new acceptance gate or calibrated biological model
